# SafeL2

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/32c74b4101392888212aa04d9da684c28a4aa416/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/SafeL2.sol)

**Inherits:** [Safe](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/contract.Safe)

**Title:** SafeL2 - An implementation of the Safe contract that emits additional events on transaction executions.

**Authors:** Stefan George - @Georgi87, Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

For a more complete description of the Safe contract, please refer to the main Safe contract `Safe.sol`.

## Functions

<a id="exectransaction-address-uint256-bytes-enum-operation-uint256-uint256-uint256-address-address-payable-bytes"></a>

### execTransaction

Executes a `operation` `0: Call, 1: DelegateCall`} transaction to `to` with `value` (Native Currency)
         and pays `gasPrice` * `gasLimit` in `gasToken` token to `refundReceiver`.

<i>

The fees are always transferred, even if the user transaction fails.
     This method doesn't perform any sanity check of the transaction, such as:
     - if the contract at `to` address has code or not
     - if the `gasToken` is a contract or not
     It is the responsibility of the caller to perform such checks.

</i>

```solidity
function execTransaction(
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        bytes calldata data,
        Enum.Operation operation,
        uint256 safeTxGas,
        uint256 baseGas,
        uint256 gasPrice,
        address gasToken,
        address payable refundReceiver,
        bytes memory signatures
    ) public payable override returns (bool);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| to | `address` | Destination address of Safe transaction. |
| value | `uint256` | Ether value of Safe transaction. |
| data | `bytes` | Data payload of Safe transaction. |
| operation | `Enum.Operation` | Operation type of Safe transaction. |
| safeTxGas | `uint256` | Gas that should be used for the Safe transaction. |
| baseGas | `uint256` | Gas costs that are independent of the transaction execution(e.g. base transaction fee, signature check, payment of the refund) |
| gasPrice | `uint256` | Gas price that should be used for the payment calculation. |
| gasToken | `address` | Token address (or 0 if ETH) that is used for the payment. |
| refundReceiver | `address payable` | Address of receiver of gas payment (or 0 if tx.origin). |
| signatures | `bytes` | Signature data that should be verified.<br/>                  Can be packed ECDSA signature (`bytes32 r``bytes32 s``uint8 v`), contract signature (EIP-1271) or approved hash. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bool` | Boolean indicating transaction's success. |

<a id="exectransactionfrommodule-address-uint256-bytes-enum-operation"></a>

### execTransactionFromModule

Execute `operation` (0: Call, 1: DelegateCall) to `to` with `value` (Native Token)

<i>

Function is virtual to allow overriding for L2 singleton to emit an event for indexing.

</i>

```solidity
function execTransactionFromModule(
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        bytes memory data,
        Enum.Operation operation
    ) public override returns (bool success);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| to | `address` | Destination address of module transaction. |
| value | `uint256` | Ether value of module transaction. |
| data | `bytes` | Data payload of module transaction. |
| operation | `Enum.Operation` | Operation type of module transaction. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| success | `bool` | Boolean flag indicating if the call succeeded. |

## Events

### SafeMultiSigTransaction

```solidity
event SafeMultiSigTransaction(
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        bytes data,
        Enum.Operation operation,
        uint256 safeTxGas,
        uint256 baseGas,
        uint256 gasPrice,
        address gasToken,
        address payable refundReceiver,
        bytes signatures,
        // We combine nonce, sender and threshold into one to avoid stack too deep
        // Dev note: additionalInfo should not contain `bytes`, as this complicates decoding
        bytes additionalInfo
    );
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| to | `address` |  |
| value | `uint256` |  |
| data | `bytes` |  |
| operation | `Enum.Operation` |  |
| safeTxGas | `uint256` |  |
| baseGas | `uint256` |  |
| gasPrice | `uint256` |  |
| gasToken | `address` |  |
| refundReceiver | `address payable` |  |
| signatures | `bytes` |  |
| additionalInfo | `bytes` |  |

### SafeModuleTransaction

```solidity
event SafeModuleTransaction(address module, address to, uint256 value, bytes data, Enum.Operation operation);
```
